name: Jito Staked SOL

expectedCapabilities.justification: Structurally required. A liquid staking token MUST mint when a user deposits SOL, otherwise the product cannot function at all. The authority is held by the stake pool program, not by a person.
expectedCapabilities.constrainedBy: The SPL stake pool program. Minting is mechanical against deposited SOL, not discretionary.

evidence.detail: Legacy Token program. decimals 9. mintAuthority ACTIVE, freezeAuthority null, verified against mainnet RPC.
Jito uses the SPL stake pool program, where the pool holds mint authority.

caveats: Mint authority being expected does not remove validator, slashing or depeg risk.
This entry speaks only to token structure, never to yield or solvency.
This archetype would false-positive on any scanner treating an active mint authority as a risk. That is the reason this entry exists.
